meta.name: og-image-design
meta.description: Open Graph and social sharing image design with platform specs, text placement, and branding. Covers OG meta tags, Twitter cards, LinkedIn previews, and dynamic generation. Use for: social sharing images, blog thumbnails, link previews, social cards. Triggers: og image, open graph, social sharing image, twitter card, social card, link preview image, og meta, sharing preview, social thumbnail, meta image, og:image, twitter:image, linkedin preview

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计社交媒体分享图片与链接预览图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网页生成美观的社交分享预览图
copy.tagline_en: Design social sharing images and link previews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create attractive social sharing images for your web pages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，使用 HTML 或 AI 生成社交分享图片（如 Open Graph 图片），并输出对应的 HTML 元标签代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“OG 图片”、“社交分享图”、“Twitter 卡片”等关键词，或要求设计链接预览图时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张博客文章的 OG 图片，标题是“如何减少 80% 构建时间”。
给我一个产品发布的社交分享图，尺寸 1200x630。
say.note: Claude 会使用模板生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate social sharing images (e.g., Open Graph images) using HTML or AI based on your request, and output corresponding HTML meta tag code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "OG image", "social sharing image", "Twitter card", or ask for a link preview image.

say_en.text: Generate an OG image for a blog post titled "How We Reduced Build Times by 80%".
say_en.note: Claude will use the HTML-to-image tool to create the image.

say_en.text: Create a product launch social sharing image, size 1200x630.
say_en.note: Claude will use a template to generate the image.
